title: job pull: an interval shorter than a pull starts overlapping runs of the same mapping, each sending a watermark read from a half-written target
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKZzp4DLtqiCkZZRM

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named seam and a measured reach (out-of-scope finding of #31778's report 6732731853, G9). ⛔ Not a claim.
reach: measured on a production-mode `os serve` at `origin/main` `c2bb879f`. A `job.pull` on a 30 s interval pulls 100,000 rows; one pull takes about 62 min. The job service started a second, third and fourth pull of the same mapping while the first was still running (4 `sys_job_run` rows `running` at once). Each sent a `since` watermark read from rows the first run had only partly written. No duplicate landed only because the target has a unique index on the key. Seam (read on main): `packages/services/service-job/src/db-job-adapter.ts` de-duplicates per deadline only, not per running job.
Business reason: a sync that runs longer than its interval piles up concurrent runs of itself. They compete for the same rows, multiply load on the source and the database, and on a target without a unique index they can write the same record twice.
Reader: the next `domain:server` seat, from `pm:queue`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `job overlapping runs`, `pull concurrent same mapping` → nothing on point.
class: a · type: Bug
Grade: p2. Load amplification on a live door, with duplicate writes possible where the target has no unique index.

## 维护者速读

定时同步任务的间隔比一次同步耗时短时，上一次还没跑完，调度器就会再启动同一个任务，实测同时跑了 4 个。它们抢着写同一批数据，读到的增量水位也不对。这张卡让同一个拉取任务在上一次还在跑时不再重复启动，这一轮记为跳过。

## What to build

1. A `job.pull` (at least; any job if the adapter's shape makes that the simpler rule, say which) does not start while a run of the same job is still `running` on any node. The skipped tick is recorded (a `sys_job_run` row or a log line, say which) so an operator sees why a tick did nothing.
2. A `running` row from a process that has stopped must not block the job forever: state how a stale run is told apart (lease or heartbeat expiry, if the adapter has one). Orphan `running` rows after shutdown are the related observation in #31778 (G7).
3. Tests: a job whose run outlasts its interval → one run at a time, the skipped tick recorded. RED on main (overlapping runs). CONTROL: a job that finishes inside its interval still fires every tick.

## Surface

- Expected file surface: `packages/services/service-job/src/db-job-adapter.ts` and its tests, root `.changeset/`. Name any other file in the PR.
- Clause-②: no.

Related: #31778 (G7, G9), epic #31763.
